_how_it_works: Can't-Miss Shows (HOT) in the Next 30 Days view. Only shows listed here are featured, up to 5 at a time, soonest first. Each entry names an event in events.json by its exact 'link' AND 'date' (the site's event ID), gives one specific 'why' line, the 'evidence' links that back it up, the 'signals' it meets, and the date the evidence was 'checked'. A show qualifies with one strong signal (demand-added date, venue upgrade, rare Arizona stop or reunion, hometown release show, one-off collaboration) or two different supporting signals. Suggestions arrive weekly in hot-candidates.json; check the evidence before approving. Past, canceled and sold-out shows drop off the featured list automatically and stay in the calendar.
